name: job-description
description: Write a performance-based job description. Use when the user says "write a JD", "draft a job posting", "create a job description", "help me post this role", "write requirements for this position", or wants to define what success looks like in a role - even if they don't explicitly say "job description". Also use when a hiring manager says "I need someone who can do X, Y, Z" and needs that translated into a structured posting.
